definitions.explanation: The maximum speed legally permitted on a road or in a given area. Also used more broadly for speed restrictions on data transfer, machinery, etc.

examples.japanese: {速度制限|そくどせいげん}を{守|まも}ってください。
この{道路|どうろ}の{速度制限|そくどせいげん}は{時速|じそく}40キロだ。
examples.english: The speed limit on this road is 40 km/h.

examples.japanese: {通学路|つうがくろ}では{速度制限|そくどせいげん}が{厳|きび}しく{設定|せってい}されている。
examples.english: Strict speed limits are set on school routes.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly seen on road signs in Japan. The standard speed limit on regular roads is {時速|じそく}60キロ, and on expressways {時速|じそく}100キロ, unless otherwise posted.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {速度制限|そくどせいげん}を{守|まも}る (to observe the speed limit)
- {速度制限|そくどせいげん}を{超|こ}える (to exceed the speed limit)
- {速度制限|そくどせいげん}{標識|ひょうしき} (speed limit sign)
- {速度制限|そくどせいげん}{違反|いはん} (speed limit violation)
